description: This file defines structures, callback types, and function prototypes for handling WPA control events, including custom message processing, event callbacks, and parsing functions related to Wi-Fi management and radio events.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_getValueStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with a key from a data buffer.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_getValueInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value associated with a key from a data buffer.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_getValueIntExt
methods.description: Retrieves an extended integer value associated with a key from a data buffer.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_fetchEvent
methods.description: Parses a message to extract the event name and arguments, optionally matching against a list of known events.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_parseMsg
methods.description: Parses a message to extract event name and arguments, returning true if successful.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_freqParamToChanSpec
methods.description: Converts channel frequency parameter from message into swl chanspec structure.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_chWidthDescToChanSpec
methods.description: Converts channel width description from message into swl chanspec structure.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrl_chWidthIdToChanSpec
methods.description: Converts channel width ID from message into swl chanspec structure.
